name: Creator Studio Bridge
description: YouTube Automation Creator Studio ka agent bridge — ideas, pipeline, videos, brain, skills, analytics. Studio local server se baat karta hai.

mcp_tools.name: studio_health
mcp_tools.description: Check Creator Studio server status + channel summary. Shuru me ek baar call karo; error aaye to Studio mode kholne ka bolo (floating switcher me Studio button) aur stop.

mcp_tools.name: studio_ideas_list
mcp_tools.description: Idea Bank ke saare ideas (topic, details, status: new/picked/done). Agli video banane se PEHLE yahi list dekho — owner ke ideas pehle.

mcp_tools.name: studio_idea_add
mcp_tools.description: Idea Bank me naya idea add karo (topic + details).

details.description: Kya hai, kyun banana chahiye, kya cover karna hai

mcp_tools.name: studio_pipeline_list
mcp_tools.description: Production runs ka status — har run ke 8 stages (research → packaging → script → voiceover → visuals → edit → final_packaging → seo_prep) ka state + notes.

mcp_tools.name: studio_pipeline_start
mcp_tools.description: Idea Bank ke idea se production run START karo — run banta hai, research stage active ho jata hai. Response me poora run milta hai.

ideaId.description: studio_ideas_list se mila idea ka id

mcp_tools.name: studio_stage_next
mcp_tools.description: Run ka ACTIVE stage complete karke next stage shuru karo (stage ka kaam PEHLE khatam karo, phir ye call karo). Response me run + next stage ka guidance milta hai.

mcp_tools.name: studio_run_retry
mcp_tools.description: Failed run ko wahin se resume karo (failed stage wapas active).

mcp_tools.name: studio_video_list
mcp_tools.description: Channel ke saare video records — title, topic, status, script, packaging (title/description/tags/chapters/end screen/pinned comment), pipeline skills, experiments, metrics.

mcp_tools.name: studio_video_record
mcp_tools.description: Video record CREATE/UPDATE karo (upsert). Packaging stage par title+titleNote, script stage par script, seo_prep par packaging (description/tags/hashtags/chapters/endScreen/pinnedComment), metrics upload ke baad. Fields validated hote hain.

id.description: Existing record ka id (update) — naya banao to mat do

packaging.description: seo_prep output — video detail me 'Upload Package' section isi se banta hai

mcp_tools.name: studio_brain_get
mcp_tools.description: Brain ka pura data — analyzed videos (problems/findings), open questions, experiment reports + enabled techniques. Video banane se pehle relevant sections yahi se padho.

mcp_tools.name: studio_brain_question_add
mcp_tools.description: Brain me research question add karo (kisi video ki problem se seekha kuch to yahan likho taaki agli video me na dohraya jaye).

areas.description: Problem areas — inme se: packaging, thumbnail, retention, ctr, seo, voiceover, editing, content, upload, analytics

mcp_tools.name: studio_experiment_toggle
mcp_tools.description: Brain experiment techniques enable/disable karo (poora experiment: setAll=true + enabled; ek item: itemId + enabled).

mcp_tools.name: studio_settings_get
mcp_tools.description: Studio Settings — kaunsi integrations connected hain (youtube/tts/etc), content language, default kind, autoUpload preferences. API keys MASKED aati hain (raw nahi milti).

mcp_tools.name: studio_skill_list
mcp_tools.description: Installed skills (packages) — naam, version, enabled skills ki list. Stage ka kaam karne se pehle relevant skill yahan se dhundo.

mcp_tools.name: studio_skill_get
mcp_tools.description: Ek skill package ka file content padho (path na do to skill ka summary).

path.description: Package ke andar file ka relative path (optional)

mcp_tools.name: studio_analytics_get
mcp_tools.description: Channel analytics summary (dashboard computed data) — totals, health, trend. Decision lene se pehle dekho.
